## Our story

This is a **content-commerce** landing page: an article and its products on one page. Edit it at `/content/commerce/pages/welcome.json`, or add your own page document — the publisher projects it to the public storefront.

- Author prose in *markdown* or HTML blocks
- Drop in product showcases by **tag** or by explicit IDs
- Embedded product cards link into the storefront and show live stock
Tag products with `featured` in Shopify (or via PIM) to curate this section. No featured products yet? They'll appear here once tagged and published.
